scope: M12-B3 enemy level stat construction only; no M12-C search

runtimeChain.result: Routes WorldDifficult, Fix, Dungeon, and Task policies to produce CreateMonsterData.lv.
Reads TDEnemy, TDUnitProperty, and TDEnemyPack; selects enemy_pack.templateID when non-zero, otherwise TDEnemy.enemyType.
Constructs level template value id as (3000 + selector) * 1000 + level and loads both base and level TDTemplateValue rows.
Multiplies matching base and level attributes; divides only the normalized attribute ids by 10000.
injectAttrs replaces calculated AttrInfo entries; attScale then multiplies baseValue by scale / 10000.
Commits the resulting dictionary as monster base properties.

requestedAttributeEffects.elementDefenses61To70: base * coefficient; present client rows use coefficient 1
requestedAttributeEffects.workbenchMultipliers: hpMultiplier, defenseMultiplier, and toughnessMultiplier are final user-configured multipliers after client level growth

selectorAndDifficulty.enemyPackTemplateId: Primary curve selector when greater than zero.
selectorAndDifficulty.enemyType: Fallback curve selector only when enemy_pack.templateID is zero.
selectorAndDifficulty.worldDifficulty: Selects the enemy level through levelPolicy/world_difficulty_obj_level; no separate difficulty field is read by InitMonsterData.
selectorAndDifficulty.dungeonDifficulty: Selects the enemy level through EntityLevelUtility.GetEnemyLevelByDungeon; separate runtime injectAttrs/attScale may still be supplied by the scene.
selectorAndDifficulty.bossOrMonsterType: Not an unconditional multiplier. It can choose a curve only through the enemyType fallback.
selectorAndDifficulty.templateDifficulty: Cross-check/index table. Its legacy GetDifficulty wrapper had no direct call xref in this client path; the live path constructs TDTemplateValue ids directly.

failClosedBoundaries.missingTemplateProfile: No enemyType or hero growth guess is substituted.
failClosedBoundaries.missingLevelRow: No interpolation or extrapolation is performed.
failClosedBoundaries.sceneAttributeScale: Reported as not configured in Workbench; no guessed scene multiplier is applied.

generatedCoverage.supportedRows: templates 1/2/3/4/5/7/8/9/10/11 have Lv1-Lv110; template 12 has Lv1-Lv80
